The reduction is complete and verified.

**Summary:**
- `reduce.py` implements the standard Vertex Cover → Clique reduction: map `(G, k)` to `(complement(G), n - k)`. A set S is a vertex cover of G iff V\S is a clique in the complement graph, so G has a cover of size ≤ k exactly when complement(G) has a clique of size ≥ n−k. It runs in O(n²) time and never calls any solver.
- `solvers.py` contains brute-force solvers for both problems from the definitions.
- `test_reduce.py` exhaustively tests all graphs on 0–4 vertices across a range of k values, plus 3000 random instances on up to 8 vertices and explicit edge cases — 3674 tests, all passing.
- `verdict.json` records `{"verified": true, "tests_run": 3674, "tests_passed": 3674}`.
